expect_red: a stack's verdict is its worst RESULT check, taken with the same combiner a study's is and never off a sensitivity probe

mutations.contract: A stack's rail verdict is its worst RESULT check. A sensitivity probe is the same check with an undocumented input moved and the stack page stamps it NOT A RESULT, so drawing a row red on a what-if is "true of the model, false of the hardware".
mutations.note: Live data cannot discriminate here and that is why the synthetic fixture exists: m1's probes are themselves `fail` and m2's worst probe verdict is `marginal`, so the [real] leaf-row pin does not move under this mutation. PROBE_FAIL_STACK is the only thing that can see it.
